title: Starter Commander Decks: card flavor text

entities.name: Atarka

entities.name: Tarkir

entities.name: Ayagor

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: A speaker who advises securing inner peace before waging war.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A figure in whose name an archon raises his sword until she is freed.

events.summary: Heliod placed the sun into the Champion's hand, as told in the Theriad.
events.quote: The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.

events.summary: The Eternals clashed with squadrons of angels in the clouds known as the Sky Theater.
events.quote: Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

events.summary: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to survivors.
events.quote: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

events.summary: The Eldrazi awakened and reasserted mastery over Zendikar's natural forces.
events.quote: As they awakened, the Eldrazi reasserted their mastery over all of Zendikar's natural forces.

events.summary: The demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.
events.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

events.summary: Liliana embraced necromancy on Innistrad, practicing on the undead and sometimes the living.
events.quote: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis moved to seize New Capenna by usurping its hidden power networks; Xander's Maestros fell first.
events.quote: Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

events.summary: The Kargan ancestors won a costly victory over the Akoum Skyclave.
events.quote: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

events.summary: Malfegor rose over the battlefield, giving the angels a chance to end a millennia-old war.
events.quote: The blood of the demons quickened as their master rose over the battlefield.

events.summary: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze.
events.quote: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the chances of the other guilds.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi; Jace questions how that worked last time.
events.quote: "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.
